headline: Software pioneer Margaret Hamilton dies at 90
summary: Margaret Hamilton, whose team's code kept Apollo 11's Moon landing on course, has died at 90. She also coined the term 'software engineering' and founded two software companies.

claims.statement: Margaret Hamilton, the software pioneer behind Apollo 11's guidance code, died at 90.
